name: @office/workflows
description: Office workflow/approval engine (OFF-016): versioned workflow definitions that are immutable once published (a definition change is a NEW version; instances pin their version), deterministic state machines over typed states and guarded typed transitions (conditions + required capabilities), typed task lifecycles with assignment actor kinds/roles and SLA windows measured against the injected clock, capability-gated policy-checked approval steps (an approval-requiring action cannot bypass policy; denials are audited), bounded deterministic retries (typed retry policy with backoff parameters from the definition), SLA escalation with definition-driven reassignment, and audit events through the EventSink port (mirroring the landed domain modules). Pure domain: no SQL, no migrations, no repository layer — deterministic, in-memory-testable, injected clock/id suppliers. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/persistence (the EventSink port's executor type), and @office/events (the ledger-backed sink adapter).
